Description: Uncontrolled scope or screen additions could break the approved workflow and safety boundary
Trigger: New feature field role or state requested
Response: Assess impact traceability and dependency before approve/defer

Description: Policy-defined timing thresholds may be mistaken for established clinical SLAs
Trigger: Need to configure an SLA or report performance
Response: Use illustrative synthetic thresholds only and label them as planned validation inputs

Description: Screen specifications data dictionary and business rules may remain incomplete before build
Response: Do not approve affected requirement for prototype until the definition-of-ready checks pass
Related decision or requirement: screen specifications; data dictionary; business rules

Description: Synthetic fixture or event version may not support required state/audit test evidence
Trigger: SIT preparation reveals missing or inconsistent source fixture
Response: Record discrepancy reconcile fixture and retest through the Sprint 6 tracker

Description: AI sample output may be unsupported stale or missing required context
Trigger: AI evaluation or reviewer identifies unsupported or stale content
Response: Record disposition use manual fallback and prevent operational reliance

Description: Relevant reviewer participation may not be available for the planned validation window
Trigger: Sprint 7 reviewer plan cannot confirm suitable roles
Response: Record limitation and do not overstate validation; rescope evidence claim if required

Description: No live team rate capacity or vendor cost evidence exists for story-level budgeting
Trigger: Request for currency budget or ROI claim
Response: Use relative effort and transparent scenario assumptions only; do not present story budget as fact
